name: Kat Hickey
review: I have been a consistent student of Kat's for seven months and have learned so much, not only about the practice of Yoga but the practice of being in place of doing. Her music brings together modern trends with healing foundation, regularly finding the bass line affording increased grounding. While Kat certainly challenges me, it is with gentle invitation to accept while growing, embrace while changing, and savor while improving. This is a delicate harmony I have only experienced with her and words won't do the experience justice. Highly recommend taking class with her and seeing your own development emerge in her tender care, one class, one pose, one breath at a time.

name: Raegan Sweeney
review:
I’m so grateful to have been introduced to yoga through Kat. She has such a natural ability to inspire and guide others, making every experience feel welcoming, peaceful, and meaningful.


     She is truly a bright light and has been such a wonderful source of guidance and encouragement on my yoga journey. I couldn’t recommend her more!

name: Briana Rocco
review: I always enjoy attending Kat’s classes! She’s always so sweet and friendly. She has awesome energy during every one of her classes that I attend. I love how she cheers you on and keeps you motivated! 💪🏼🤍

name: Nicole Parsons
review:
Kat has such a graceful and artistic way of holding space for others. She doesn’t simply teach yoga; she embodies what she teaches in the way she moves through the world, with curiosity, creativity, presence, and genuine care for the people around her.

Her classes invite you to stay with yourself, especially in those moments of uncertainty when a pose asks you to breathe, explore, and resist the urge to rush toward what comes next. There is both intention and freedom in the way she teaches, creating space to be challenged without losing connection to yourself.

What stands out most is how deeply Kat cares about her students. You feel seen in her presence, while still being given the space to have an experience that is entirely your own. Practicing with her feels less like being told how yoga should look and more like being invited to discover what it can feel like in your own body.

name: Kristin Walsh
review:
I’ve been taking Kat’s classes for about three years, originally starting with her at The Yoga Parlor, and I can honestly say she is one of those instructors who leaves a lasting impression. Her energy is contagious. She radiates positivity and genuine joy in everything she does. Kat is incredibly welcoming and has a way of making everyone feel comfortable right away. Even if you’re brand new to a studio, she greets you with a smile and makes you feel like you’ve been there for years. She is so easy to talk to and genuinely cares about her students. You could walk into class having a hard day, and after even a quick conversation with Kat, you somehow leave feeling a little lighter and more positive. You can tell how passionate Kat is about teaching and sharing her love of yoga with every student. Her classes have an uplifting energy that leaves you feeling stronger, energized, and inspired. She challenges you while also reminding you to listen to yourself and meet yourself where you are.

What I love most about Kat is that her message goes beyond the physical practice. She encourages everyone to be the best version of themselves and reminds us how important it is to take time for ourselves, show up for ourselves, and truly be present in the moment. Her classes are an opportunity to reset, recharge, and walk out feeling like you can take on whatever comes next. Kat brings so much heart, positivity, and authenticity to every class, and I’m so grateful to have been practicing with her for the past three years!
